scope.method: Sequential sentence-level reading of each scoped source page with line numbers, including public title/description/answer and full article body; all three hub field sets and six information/error pages read. Keyword scanning was not used as the coverage basis. Existing dist is read only for confirming visible output; no build or tests repeated.
scope.limits: Public URLs identify intended routes, not proof of the currently deployed revision. No live crawl, new source research, game playtest, SEO/GEO scores, image alt/hreflang/schema research, account configuration check, publication, or indexing action.
